set.q:
다음 문장에서 어법상 어색한 부분의 기호는?
She wanted neither (A)to wait for the bus (B)nor (C)taking (D)a taxi.
set.why: neither A nor B로 이어진 두 어구는 형태가 같아야 하므로 (C)는 앞의 to wait for the bus와 같은 to take a taxi 형태여야 해요.

patches.why: Original sentence had a misplaced correlative (neither before wanted, nor before a bare gerund), so (A) neither wanted ... nor to take is also non-parallel; rewritten with neither placed before the infinitive (stem q changed, key now (C)).
